english.title: Driver of goods vehicle fail to produce copy of posting declaration for inspection / copying
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE TYPE AND INDEX MARK..), used on a commercial journey for the carriage of goods

(A)_[between member States]_
(B)_[within a member State]_

namely **(..SPECIFY STATE OR STATES..) and without reasonable excuse, breached a requirement under regulation 25(2)(b) of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024 to produce a copy of the posting declaration that was carried on the vehicle and allow the examiner to inspect and copy it
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 25(2)(b) and 27(3) and (7) of the Goods Vehicles (International Road Transport Permits and Haulage Within the EU) Regulations 2024.
